1.title: Dario Amodei of Anthropic to Dine With Trump at White House
1.summary: Dario Amodei, who is also the company’s chief executive, will join the president at the White House for a private dinner. Mr. Trump has dismissed his cautions.

2.title: A Trump 2024 Campaign Ad Returns, Now Brought to You by the Government
2.summary: The ad, which ethics experts said could violate federal law, shows Mr. Trump vowing to “expel the warmongers” from the government and fight the “deep state,” even as he wages a war with Iran.

3.title: Giant Pandas, Icons of China’s Soft Diplomacy, Arrive in Atlanta
3.summary: A male named Ping Ping and a female named Fu Shuang landed on Sunday, days after China’s leader said he would dispatch “envoys of friendship” to the United States.

4.title: Iran Still Awaits ‘Official’ U.S. Response Despite Trump’s Rebuff of Cease-Fire Offer
4.summary: Abbas Araghchi, Iran’s foreign minister, said a history of contradictory messaging meant that President Trump’s rejection might not be a final position.

5.title: Serbia’s Longtime President Aleksandar Vucic Resigns Post
5.summary: Aleksandar Vucic, one of Europe’s longest-serving leaders, resigned as president, paving the way for him to become prime minister after elections next month.

6.title: A Transcript From The Times Interview with Prime Minister Mark Carney of Canada
6.summary: New York Times journalists pressed the Canadian prime minister about a range of topics in an hourlong interview last week. Here’s a transcript of their conversation.
